headline: Sensex and Nifty drop sharply amid heavy selling in banking and metal stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy selling pressure was witnessed in banking and metal stocks.
Profit-taking after a four-week rally dragged Indian benchmark indices down.
Sensex tumbled over 1,400 points from opening highs amid market volatility.
Financial sector shares faced downward pressure during the trading session.
whatHappening: Sensex shed over 1,400 points while Nifty dropped below the 25,400 mark.
Investors lost over Rs 6 lakh crore in market capitalization as indices plummeted.
Paytm announced a partnership with ChargeZone for QR payments at 15,000 EV charging points.
Marksans Pharma faced selling pressure after receiving 6 U.S. FDA observations for its Goa unit.
summary: Indian benchmark equity indices suffered steep losses on Monday due to heavy selling in banking and metal stocks following profit-taking after a four-week rally. Sensex dropped over 1,400 points, eroding over Rs 6 lakh crore of investor wealth. Meanwhile, stock-specific movements were seen in Paytm, Apollo Micro Systems, and Marksans Pharma following corporate announcements.
